3. Learned advocate Mr.Hiren Modi for the applicant submitted that there is a delay of 10 months in registering the FIR.

Further, Public Health Centre is a place, where any person can come suddenly,
and therefore, this act could not have been possible, unless it was consented by the victim person.
The complaint is registered only because the husband of the complainant came to know about the relation between the victim and the present applicant.

He also submitted that, in fact, the victim NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/5125/2023 ORDER DATED: 20/04/2023 undefined is a illiterate person, and FIR is typed by her husband, and she has only put her thumb impression on the FIR,
therefore, the complaint is not genuine.
Learned advocate, therefore, submitted that considering the above facts, the applicant may be granted anticipatory bail.

4. Learned Additional Public Prosecutor appearing on behalf of the respondent - State has vehemently opposed the application and submitted that the delay has sufficiently been explained by the complainant as she was blackmailed by the applicant, therefore, she could not gather the courage to tell her husband about the incident occurred.

He further pointed out from the FIR itself that even at any point of time, it was not the complaint to inform her husband about the such incident but the present applicant himself informed the husband of the complainant that he is having relationship with the wife and that is how the husband of the complainant came to know about the incident, and thereafter upon inquiry, the present present applicant gathered NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/5125/2023 ORDER DATED: 20/04/2023 undefined the courage and narrated the correct facts of her husband.
Therefore, it was delay of 10 months the same has been sufficiently been explained.
Considering the fact that the present applicant has not only raped the victim thrice, but also have tried to blackmail her, it would increase the seriousness of the offence in question.
Therefore, considering the aforesaid aspects, he may not be granted anticipatory bail.
5. As the custodial interrogation would be required in the facts of the case.

sentences.text: I have considered the fact that victim is illiterate lady, who continued to tolerate the harassment and physical abuse from the present applicant just to save her marriage life as the present applicant was blackmailing her.

Further in the FIR, it is specifically mentioned by the NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/5125/2023 ORDER DATED: 20/04/2023 undefined complainant alongwith the date and time, how the incident took place, and therefore, prima facie, FIR seems to be genuine, and serious allegations are levelled against the present applicant.
I do not say any reason to protect the present applicant by granting anticipatory bail.

7. Further, the case of the applicant that the PHC is a place where anytime anyone can come and unless it is the consensual act, the offence could not have taken place is concerned, the same is a matter of evidence, for which also, the fair investigation is required at this stage, for which, custodial interrogation, if required by the police to be necessary.
Therefore, considering the totality and the facts of seriousness of offence, I do not say any reason to grant anticipatory bail to the present applicant.
Accordingly, the present application is required to be dismissed and the same is dismissed.
Rule is discharged.
Interim relief, if any, granted earlier, stands vacated.
